Name: Trash4Elliott
Author: ChrisMzz
Description:
This mod adds Trash to the player's inventory every time Elliott enters the same area as the player, and every time the player enters an area that Elliott is in.

Using this mod, you'll never feel like you forgot your trash at home when you see Elliott, so you'll always have a shot at gifting him some trash. I made this for myself, and if it can help someone else scratch that itch of hating Elliott, that makes me happy :)

Compatible with 1.6!

Manifest.Name: Trash4Elliott
Manifest.Description: Makes sure you always have trash to give Elliott.
